name: Nomura Streetwear Heated Core Layer
description:
An affordable heated base layer with resistive elements focused on the torso core — chest, kidneys, and lower back. A small rechargeable battery in the waistband provides six hours of heat on a single charge. The fabric is basic polyester-blend; the technology is simple and reliable.

The cheapest heated underlayer on the market, sold at Shelf district vendors during winter months. The Heated Core Layer doesn't regulate temperature intelligently — it just adds heat where your body needs it most. Simple, warm, and accessible to people who can't afford smart-fabric solutions.
functionality: Core-area heating, 6-hour battery life, basic thermal support
what_it_says: You're cold and you spent what you could to stay warm where it matters most.
story_hooks: A Heated Core Layer's battery is found drained in an environment that wasn't cold — someone used the resistive heating elements for something other than warmth.
